### index

- **index** · self — Indexes speed up queries by allowing efficient lookups on specific fields. Use `.withIndex()` in your queries to leverage them. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing, indexed — file:///Users/mitch/.global-ai-hub/llms-full/files/docs.convex.dev.txt#index-index-direct-link-to-index

### text index

- **text index** · hyponym — Text indexes tokenize and stem the terms in the indexed fields for the index entries. The index uses simple [language-specific](https://www.mongodb.com#std-label-text-index-supported-languages) suffix stemming. For each document in the collection, the text index stores one index entry for each uniqu · aka: text indexes, full-text index, search index, search indexes, withSearchIndex, tsvector, pg_trgm · full-text/search indexes (Atlas Search, Convex search index, Postgres FTS) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/index-text/text-index-properties/#index-entries

### vector index

- **vector index** · hyponym — * Vector index works only for tables **with** `ROWID` or with singular `PRIMARY KEY`. Composite `PRIMARY KEY` without `ROWID` is not supported · aka: vector indexes, HNSW, IVFFlat, DiskANN, vectorIndex, approximate nearest neighbor · pgvector / Atlas Vector Search / Convex vector index — an index type, not the Pinecone sense — https://docs.turso.tech/features/ai-and-embeddings#index-limitations
